overview.text:
**Changed**
- `index.js`: new `matchEntityRegExp` matches only `"`, `&`, `<`, `>`, `&#digits;` and `&#x/X hex;` [H3].
- `index.js:unescapeHtml`: coerces input with `'' + string`, then replaces matches. Named entities map to characters; numeric references are parsed with `parseInt` [H5].
- `index.js:unescapeHtml`: code points above `0x10FFFF` or in `0xD800`–`0xDFFF` return the original entity. Code points above `0xFFFF` become surrogate pairs [H5].
- `'` has no named case and is decoded through the decimal numeric path [H3, H5].
- `index.js`: exports the function as `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml` [H4].
- `test/unescape.test.js`: new file with 10 `node:test` cases covering round-trip, decimal/hex, surrogates, invalid, unknown/case, malformed, one-layer decoding and coercion [H6, E5].
- `README.md`: intro paragraph rewritten and a new `escapeHtml.unescape(string)` section with an example [H1, H2].

**Why**
- The user asked for a dependency-free `unescape` that reverses `escapeHtml`, leaves unknown and invalid references as-is, is tested with `node --test`, and is documented in the README [E1].
- The agent first inspected how `escapeHtml` is exported, then added the property alongside it [E2, E4].
- The agent ran the old Mocha tests under a `node:test` shim because Mocha was missing [E7, E8].

**Risks**
- `npm test` failed with exit 127 (`mocha: not found`) [E6].
- `npm test` runs `mocha test/`, which would also load the new `node:test` file. How the two interact is not verified [E6, H6].
- Existing tests passed (30/30) only through an ad-hoc `describe`/`it` shim, not the real runner [E8].
- `�` decodes to U+0000, and the test asserts this. The HTML spec maps it to U+FFFD. The request did not specify either behaviour [H6].
- The README intro paragraph was reworded, which goes beyond adding a new section [H1].
- The Node version used for the test runs is not shown [E5, E8].

mechanism.text:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
  A["unescape(string) = unescapeHtml"] --> B["'' + string coercion"]
  B --> C["str.replace(matchEntityRegExp, callback)"]
  C -->|"no regex match: © & &lt (no ;) &#x;"| D["text left unchanged"]
  C -->|"match: entity, decimal, hex"| E["switch(entity)"]
  E -->|"" & < >"| F["return literal char"]
  E -->|"numeric ref, incl. '"| G["codePoint = parseInt(decimal,10) or parseInt(hex,16)"]
  G -->|"> 0x10FFFF or 0xD800-0xDFFF"| H["return entity unchanged"]
  G -->|"<= 0xFFFF"| I["String.fromCharCode(codePoint)"]
  G -->|"0x10000-0x10FFFF"| J["codePoint -= 0x10000; surrogate pair"]
  F --> K["decoded string, one layer"]
  H --> K
  I --> K
  J --> K
  D --> K
```

- **Export:** `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml` attaches the decoder as a property of the existing `escapeHtml` export. The test `exports unescape alongside...` checks both are functions [H4, H6].
- **Coercion:** `'' + string` converts the input to a string first. The last test covers `undefined`, `null`, `42`, `{}` and an object whose `toString` returns `'<'` (result `'<'`) [H5, H6].
- **Regex gate:** `matchEntityRegExp` is `/&(?:quot|amp|lt|gt|#([0-9]+)|#[xX]([0-9a-fA-F]+));/g`. It is case-sensitive and requires a trailing `;` [H3].
  - Unknown or uppercase names (`©`, `&`, `&constructor;`) never reach the callback, so they stay untouched [H6].
  - Malformed refs (`&quot `, `&#;`, `&#-1;`, `&#xGG;`) are also untouched [H6].
- **Named branch:** the `switch(entity)` maps the four named entities to `"`, `&`, `<`, `>`. `'` has no case here, so it falls through to the numeric path [H5].
  - Test `decodes all entities emitted by escapeHtml` checks that `unescape(escapeHtml(original)) === original` [H6].
- **Numeric parse:** capture group 1 (decimal) or group 2 (hex) is passed to `parseInt` with radix 10 or 16 [H5].
  - Tests: `<` (leading zeros), and `<` / `<` (both prefix cases) [H6].
- **Invalid guard:** values above `0x10FFFF` or in the surrogate range return the original `entity` instead of throwing [H5].
  - Inputs: `�`, `�`, `�`, `�`, plus huge digit strings. Those parse to very large numbers and fail the `> 0x10FFFF` check [H6].
- **BMP path:** code points up to `0xFFFF` go to `String.fromCharCode`. Boundary inputs are `�`, `퟿`, `` and `` [H5, H6].
- **Supplementary path:** the code subtracts `0x10000` and emits `0xD800 + (cp >> 10)` and `0xDC00 + (cp & 0x3FF)` [H5].
  - Tests: `😀` and `😀` decode to `\uD83D\uDE00`; `` decodes to `\uDBFF\uDFFF` [H6].
- **Single layer:** `replace` runs once without re-scanning its output, so `&lt;` becomes `<`. Test `decodes one layer per call` checks this [H5, H6].
- **Verification:**
  - `node --test test/unescape.test.js` exited 0 with 10 tests passing [E5, E9].
  - The existing tests passed 30/30 via a `node:test` shim [E8].
  - `npm test` failed with exit 127 (`mocha: not found`) [E6].
  - Not shown: the full assertion output was truncated in the transcript [E5].
